# The centrifuge controller log

Every log line starts with a timestamp. Logs use the clock stated in the file header.

turns.prompt: Someone in Beijing needs to know when the first IMBALANCE_TRIP shows up in the centrifuge controller log, in their own time. The file is lab/centrifuge.log. Just the clock time, HH:MM:SS.
